title: The Feathered Scout
intro: Within a kingdom ruled by one granted dominion over the winds, the unseen beings, and the creatures of the sky, one small and swift member vanished from the ranks — only to return with revelations that would reshape the fate of a distant nation. This keen-eyed informant brought truth to light where ignorance had taken root. Who Am I?
clues: I served in a court where humans, unseen beings, and creatures of the sky answered to a single wise ruler who commanded the very winds.
I was absent from my post for a time, and the ruler's wrath was promised should I fail to provide a satisfactory reason.
I am a small creature of flight, known for sharp sight, and my kind was honored with direct naming in the pages of revelation.
When I returned, I brought news of a distant land where the people prostrated to the sun, blind to the One who created the heavens and the earth.
I found a woman ruling over a great kingdom, sitting upon a magnificent throne, never having known the truth before.
I am the one who discovered the realm of Saba' and carried a letter of invitation from a prophet-king who was given dominion over the wind.

arabic: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verse: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars. (27:27)
